targets.behavior: Packaged export NAME_OR_ID --output PATH writes a complete agent-export-v1 archive atomically to an explicit absent destination; existing destination, unsupported schema, missing object bytes, network failure and unauthorized identity fail without a false complete archive. The product native importer can consume the result.
targets.evidence: cli-export suite: real packaged export and native import round-trip, integrity manifest and local filesystem readback across each named failure.
targets.why: Real packaged command behavior requires independent CLI evidence and sealed results.
targets.fail: Any declared positive/negative case differs, a required command is absent, or evidence does not exercise the real surface.
